about: How the synthetic Guarani voice (facebook/mms-tts-grn, tools/make-tts.py) is given the words that are not Guarani spelling: Spanish names, numbers and loans inside Guarani lines. For the synthesis text only: the screens and the manifest keep the course's spelling. The voice reads letters the Guarani way (c before i as «ch» or «k»; a word without a written mark with the stress on its last vowel), so a Spanish word is written here as a Guarani speaker would spell what is said: h for the jota, k for c and qu, s for c and z, and the acute on the stressed vowel when it is not the last. 'words': the course's word in lower case → what the voice is given, and why. 'as_written': the start of names that are Guarani spelling and are said as written, with any suffix (Itauguápe). 'spanish': the Spanish number words. A line of the Guarani voices made of these words alone is said by the Spanish voice, unshifted, when one of its words is marked "voice": "es" below (the Guarani voice cannot say it) or has no entry at all (it was never tried); a number the Guarani voice says right stays with it. A word that is not here and is not Guarani spelling stops tools/make-tts.py, with its key. The spellings are sound; what the voice then says is another matter: it has no f, no dependable l (it fails at the start of a word, between vowels and at the end), no ld, rl or tr, no d without n, and no respelling repairs that (sound/VOICE.md, «How the text is prepared»). Every entry was said three times or more and sent through two speech recognisers, in the first round, in the verification (three seeds each inside «che réra …») or in the fix round; none was heard by a person.

juan.why: The Spanish jota. After «che réra» the model says the name with an h by itself, but after «mba'éichapa» it came back «joan»; with h it is the same every time. Heard right by the large recogniser 3 times of 3.

josé.why: The Spanish jota; the last vowel is stressed without a mark. Heard right 3 times of 3.

jose.why: The same name written without its accent.

lucas.why: c before a is k, and the stress is on the u: with the acute the independent recogniser writes «…úkas» in 6 takes of 6; without it, in 1 of 6. NOT RENDERED: the l that opens the word («ndúka», «nucas» in 4 hearings of 6). No respelling repairs it.

lucía.why: c before i is s. As «lucía» it came back «luchía», «lukía». NOT RENDERED: the l that opens the word («ndusía», «nusía» in 4 hearings of 6).

lucia.why: The same name written without its accent.

luis.why: As written; listed because it ends in a consonant. NOT RENDERED: the l that opens the word («ndúi» from the independent recogniser 3 times of 3); the last s is weak.

marta.why: The stress is on the first a; the acute keeps it there. Heard right in 2 or 3 takes of 3.

mateo.why: The stress is on the e. Without the acute it came back «mate'o», a break before the o. Heard right 3 times of 3.

nilda.why: The stress is on the i. NOT RENDERED: the cluster ld (garbled in 6 hearings of 6: «níva», «nírda», «nída»).

pedro.why: The stress is on the e. The model knows the name; heard right in 2 or 3 takes of 3.

ramona.why: The stress is on the o. With the acute the o is 52 ms longer against the last a than without, and the large recogniser writes «ramóna» or «ramóma» in 6 takes of 6; without it, never. Heard right 3 times of 3.

rosa.why: The stress is on the o. With the acute the recognisers write «rósa» in 8 hearings of 12; without it, in none. The r is the soft Guarani r, not the strong first r of Spanish. Heard right 3 times of 3.

ana.why: The stress is on the first a. With the acute the recognisers write «á…» in 12 hearings of 12; without it, in none. Heard right 3 times of 3.

carlos.why: c before a is k; the stress is on the a. NOT RENDERED: the cluster rl («cálos» in 5 hearings of 6).

sofía.why: As written: the stress is marked already. NOT RENDERED: the f («sosía» in 5 hearings of 6).

sofia.why: The same name written without its accent.

tomás.why: As written; listed because it ends in a consonant. Heard right 3 times of 3.

tomas.why: The same name written without its accent.

luque.why: qu is k, and the stress is on the u. NOT RENDERED: the l that opens the word («ndúke», «núke» in 6 hearings of 6).

argentina.why: g before e is the jota: h. The stress is on the i. The r before the h is lost, as in Argentina-gua.

argentina-gua.why: The place name with -gua, as one word: h for the jota, no hyphen (the model has a hyphen that makes no sound of its own), and no acute, because -gua takes the stress. The r is lost: «ahentinagua» from both recognisers.

diez.why: z is s. Only for a number inside a Guarani sentence: a line that is nothing but a Spanish number with this word in it goes to the Spanish voice (see 'spanish'), because the Guarani voice has no d without n and drops a last l: «diez mil» came back garbled («riesmi», «ndiehmi», «liémi») in each of the eight spellings tried.

mil.why: As written; listed because it ends in a consonant. The last l is not said: the two recognisers heard «mi» in 5 hearings of 6, «miĩ» in the other.

veinte.why: The stress is on the e. Came back «véinte» from both recognisers in 6 takes of 6, and from the large one 3 times of 3 in the verification.

treinta.why: The stress is on the e. NOT RENDERED: the cluster tr. Alone, as «tréinta», it came back «téinta» from the independent recogniser 6 times of 6 and «ténta» or «téinta» from the large one in 4 of 6; without the acute, «tereinta» (6 of 6). So a line that is only this number goes to the Spanish voice («treinta» in 2 takes of 3); inside a Guarani sentence it is said «tréinta», flawed.

cuarenta.why: c is k; the stress is on the e. Alone it came back «kuarénta» from the independent recogniser in 5 takes of 6 and «cuarenta», «kuarenta» from the large one in 6 of 6; inside «oguereko … ary», «kuarénta» 3 times of 3 (independent).

cincuenta.why: c is s and k; the stress is on the e. NOT RENDERED: the n before k («cikenta», «si cuenta» in 10 hearings of 12). A line that is only this number goes to the Spanish voice («cincuenta» 3 times of 3).

sesenta.why: The stress is on the second e. Said alone by F the first s is lost for the large recogniser («esen a» twice, nothing once), though M's take is heard right 3 times of 3: not dependable, so a line that is only this number goes to the Spanish voice («sesenta» 3 of 3).

setenta.why: The stress is on the second e. As sesenta: said alone by F it came back «etenta» from the large recogniser 3 times of 3; the Spanish voice says «setenta» 3 of 3.

noventa.why: The stress is on the e. Alone it came back «novénta» from the independent recogniser and «noventa» from the large one in 6 takes of 6 each; inside «oguereko … ary», «novénta» in 2 takes of 3.

cien.why: c is s. Alone it came back «csien», «cshien», «cén», «sén»: right in 2 hearings of 12. A line that is only this number goes to the Spanish voice («cien» 3 of 3).

doce.why: c before e is s; the stress is on the o. NOT RENDERED: the d («ndose», «ndosẽ» in 15 hearings of 18: a bare d comes out as the Guarani nd). A line that is only this number goes to the Spanish voice («doce» 3 of 3); inside a Guarani sentence it is said «dóse», flawed.

ochenta.why: The stress is on the e. Alone it came back «ochénta» or «ochenta» in 6 hearings of 6 by F; in M's voice the large recogniser heard «osénta» twice in 3. The ch is the Guarani one, «sh»; after a word that ends in o the first o is swallowed («oguereko chénta»).

clara.why: As written: the model reads the Spanish spelling better than a respelling. Inside «che réra …» the large recogniser hears «clára» 3 times of 3 (as «klára», once). The l after the c is weak: «kyára» from the independent recogniser in 2 takes of 3.

elena.why: The stress is on the second e. NOT RENDERED: the l, also between vowels («evéna», «edéna», «ndéna», «rena»; an l in 4 hearings of 12, with or without the acute). Listed so that the name is found: it is Guarani spelling and would pass unnoticed.
